jem.settlements.guide.founding:
Founding
Use a real bell, choose a unique name and pay the displayed authoritative founding quote. The initial rectangle is 97 × 97 blocks. The bell must be within reach, in a loaded dimension, with enough separation from other towns. A rejected action does not create a settlement.
jem.settlements.guide.territory:
Territory
Use the native Xaero map. Hold left-drag from inside your settlement and release on the desired extension. The rectangular union can add a whole strip. Review all five Coin denominations in the native confirmation. Expansion uses positive configurable per-block and minimum prices; the server checks currency, quote, bounds and neighboring towns. Escape or closing the menu cancels the selection. Personal waypoints remain private.
jem.settlements.guide.feeding:
Feeding
Shift-right-click a container with a bell to share it with all registered residents. Hungry residents prefer their desired dish, otherwise another reachable edible item. Food is physically removed from the store. Sleeping or threatened residents wait; unloaded stock is unknown. Native hunger and serving limits still apply.
jem.settlements.guide.housing:
Housing
Up to 20 shared happiness: 10 from accessible personal beds and 10 from roofs over both bed blocks. Leaves do not count as roofs. Missing a bed produces one complaint, No home; an uncovered bed only reduces the roof contribution. Cramped beds and insufficient accessible floor space are separate personal conditions.
Open My home in resident details. LMB drag rotates, the wheel zooms. The depth slider opens the interior; Example shows an illustration. Hover a block to see its purpose.
jem.settlements.guide.food_satisfaction:
Food
Up to 20 shared happiness: 15 from average satiety and 5 from average recent food quality. Safe food scores 1–5, repeats score 1. A requested dish adds 4, capped at 5. Quality lasts one game day; harmful food or no current meal gives 0. Food does not grant a separate unlimited personal happiness bonus.
jem.settlements.guide.safety:
Safety
Safety uses actual settlement and native guard evidence. Recruits exist only with the Recruits mod. A shield icon or a Treasury balance does not create a defender. Open a registered recruit’s details and approach them for native management.
jem.settlements.guide.jobs:
Jobs
Minecraft owns ordinary villagers’ professions and workplaces. Diverse verified professions and active recruits support settlement progression. Settlements does not invent output in unloaded chunks.
jem.settlements.guide.community:
Community
Shared conditions provide up to 90 happiness: comfort 15, safety 10, housing 20, food 20, community 15 and jobs 10. PatPat gives one resident up to 10 more for one game day. Active personal penalties reduce the result.
jem.settlements.guide.decoration:
Town comfort
Paths, animals, street lighting and greenery each provide 25 comfort points. Comfort of 100/100 contributes 15 happiness. Connect homes to the centre, light streets and distribute varied plants along them. Four animal species provide the full animal contribution.
jem.settlements.guide.assign_work:
Jobs
Use real workplaces and ordinary villager professions. Villager Workers integration has been removed; Villager Recruits guards remain supported.
jem.settlements.guide.chest_delivery:
Shared containers
Mark a real container with a bell. No second food toggle is needed. Chest numbers persist for double chests and the surviving half. Residents open native chests with sound when taking food; no virtual stock or treasury conversion.
jem.settlements.guide.payroll:
Payroll
Requires Recruits. Fund the settlement treasury before wages fall due. The established cycle is seven game days. Pay overdue wages processes only genuine unpaid periods; future periods are not paid early. The server validates employer, roster, receipts and funds before committing.
jem.settlements.guide.rebellion:
Loyalty
Three missed payroll periods can make a recruit hostile. Removing a town does not erase personal debt or loyalty. A hostile recruit must actually be defeated before the former owner can use the supported native paid hire recovery. No screen click fakes defeat or employment.
jem.settlements.guide.treasury:
Treasury
All five canonical coin denominations share one currency ledger. Choose a denomination and coin count for deposits or withdrawals, then confirm the exact transfer. A pending payment stays pending until its matching server acknowledgment. Closing a window does not cancel a submitted payment. Never repeat an uncertain payment with a new intent.
jem.settlements.guide.tax:
Resident income
At 100% happiness a resident generates 40 Copper per Minecraft day; at 50%, 20 Copper. Ten residents at 100% yield 4 Gold; twenty yield 8 Gold. Issued into the treasury once per period, without a separate rate or comfort bonus.

jem.settlements.guide.territory_emerald:
Territory
Use the native Xaero map. Hold left-drag inside your settlement and release on the desired extension. The rectangular union can add a whole strip. Review the full physical Emerald price before confirmation. Standalone Emerald rates and minimums are server configured independently of Coins. Escape or closing the menu cancels the selection.
jem.settlements.guide.treasury_emerald:
Treasury
Without Economy, all settlement costs use real inventory Emeralds. Deposits remove Emeralds and credit a separate treasury; withdrawals return real Emeralds only when your inventory has space. No free starter funds or conversion of old Coins exists. Town payroll uses this treasury; a personal employer pays from inventory while online. Offline wages become arrears. Old Coin treasury and payroll remain separate. Wait for the matching server acknowledgment before issuing another payment.
